# solution.py
def read_number(n: int) -> str:
    """Return the Korean reading of n (0 <= n < 10**12)."""
    if n == 0:
        return "영"

    digits = ["이", "이", "삼", "사", "오", "육", "칠", "팔", "구"]  # index 1-9
    # Place values for a 4-digit group
    unit_pos = ["천", "백", "십", ""]

    # Units for groups of 4 digits (from lowest to highest)
    group_units = ["", "만", "억"]

    # Split n into groups of 4 digits
    groups = []
    temp = n
    while temp:
        groups.append(temp % 10000)
        temp //= 10000
    # groups[0] is lowest, groups[-1] highest
    parts = []
    for idx, grp in enumerate(groups):
        if grp == 0:
            continue
        grp_str = []
        for i, unit in enumerate(unit_pos):
            digit = grp // (10 ** (3 - i)) % 10
            if digit == 0:
                continue
            if digit == 1 and unit:  # suppress leading 1 before 천/백/십
                grp_str.append(unit)
            else:
                grp_str.append(digits[digit] + unit)
        part = "".join(grp_str)
        if group_units[idx]:
            part += group_units[idx]
        parts.append(part)
    # Reverse to get highest group first
    return "".join(reversed(parts))
